# Swami Enterprises

> Industrial sewing machine dealer and spare parts supplier based in New Delhi, India, serving garment factories and bulk/wholesale buyers pan-India (Delhi NCR, Tirupur, Ludhiana, Surat, Kolkata and other garment hubs). Authorized JACK dealer, trading since 2015. Also carries MAQI, Pegasus, JUKI, and SINGER industrial machines, and Golden Eagle / Groz-Beckert spare parts and needles, as a stocking partner (not an authorized distributor for those brands).

Website: https://swamienterprises.online
Contact / bulk quotes: https://swamienterprises.online/request-quote

## Machines

Full catalog: https://swamienterprises.online/machines (74 models)

Needle system: DBx1, 11-18#.

### MAQI
- [MAQI Q7T](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-q7t) — Lockstitch. MAQI's Q7T is an electronically controlled lockstitch machine built around quiet operation — silent electronic backtack, double-knife thread trimming that leaves a short thread end, and a closed automatic oil-pan lubrication system that keeps the machine and fabric free of oil stains.
- [MAQI Q7Ls](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-q7ls) — Lockstitch. MAQI's Q7Ls is a two-step-motor lockstitch machine from MAQI's large-sewing-space "THE-MAX" line — stepper-driven double-knife thread cutting that leaves a roughly 3mm thread tail, a sensorless easy-lift knee support, closed automatic lubrication, and optional nest-free (basting-free) technology.
- [MAQI Q6Ls THE-MAX](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-q6ls-the-max) — Lockstitch. MAQI's Q6Ls THE-MAX is the large-sewing-space model in MAQI's THE-MAX line, built for bulkier work under the arm — dual-blade smart thread cutting with an ultra-short thread tail, and a sensorless, easy-lift knee support.
- [MAQI Q5Tt](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-q5tt) — Lockstitch. MAQI's Q5Tt is a two-motor ("two-drive") step-motor smart sewing machine with 0.1mm-precision electronic needle-pitch control and nine built-in stitch patterns. MAQI states a wide material range — from light gauze and stockings up to thick stacked material (quoted as up to 120+ layers of A4 paper or 16 layers of denim). Needle system: Electronic, 0.1mm precision.
- [MAQI LS5490-4C](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls5490-4c) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS5490-4C is an upper-differential intelligent flat sewing machine built for pleating and gathering work — a servo-driven upper differential presser foot, a dual-rack lower differential mechanism, and digital pleat programming across up to 9 segments.
- [MAQI Q2Pro](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-q2pro) — Lockstitch. MAQI's Q2Pro is a direct-drive computerized lockstitch machine with automatic thread trimming — a round-knife trimmer, one-key needle-position compensation with an integrated work light, an LCD control display, and a wide 90–280V operating-voltage range for unstable power supplies. Needle system: One-key, with integrated LED work light.
- [MAQI Q1Pro](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-q1pro) — Lockstitch. MAQI's Q1Pro is a direct-drive computerized lockstitch machine with integrated intelligent control electronics, one-key needle-position compensation with a built-in work light, an LCD display, and the same wide 90–280V operating-voltage range as the Q2Pro. Needle system: One-key, with integrated LED work light.
- [MAQI LS8450Te](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls8450te) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS8450Te is a double-needle, step-motor, semi-dry-head computerized lockstitch machine — 0.1mm-precision electronic needle pitch, automatic presser-foot lift, a straight-knife thread trimmer, and electronic switching between the left and right needle. Needle system: Electronic, 0.1mm precision.
- [MAQI LS 8420DP-5](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls8420dp-5) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS 8420DP-5 is a direct-drive double-needle lockstitch machine with a 3-stage adjustable LED work light, one-key needle-position compensation, MAQI's own electronic control box with a USB port, and a semi-dry (micro-oil) head.
- [MAQI LS202Ft](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls202ft) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS202Ft is an electronic (computerized) top-and-bottom-feed lockstitch machine with a large hook and hand wheel and a round-knife thread trimmer, built for heavier feed work than a standard lockstitch head.
- [MAQI LS640E](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls640e) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS640E is an electronic top-and-bottom-feed lockstitch machine with an oversized sewing space and a stepper-motor-driven presser foot for a lighter, adjustable lift.
- [MAQI LS0303Ft-II](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls0303ft-ii) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS0303Ft-II is an electronic top-and-bottom-feed lockstitch machine with stepper-motor control, silent electronic reverse stitching, nine built-in stitch patterns, voice-guided one-touch operation, and a round-knife thread trimmer.
- [MAQI LS0313Ft](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls0313ft) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS0313Ft is an electronic top-and-bottom-feed lockstitch machine with stepper-motor control, nine built-in stitch patterns, and an oversized sewing space for bulkier work.
- [MAQI LS3820DP](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls3820dp) — Lockstitch. MAQI lists the LS3820DP under its Lockstitch series, but its own product page names it a "direct drive chain stitch sewing machine" with a curved-needle construction and a puller/feed panel — closer to a chainstitch/blind-stitch head than a standard lockstitch. Confirm the exact stitch type with a specialist before ordering. Needle system: Curved-needle construction.
- [MAQI LS5200MX-TD4](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls5200mx-td4) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS5200MX-TD4 is a computerized lockstitch machine with a built-in edge cutter, a 26mm feed range for bulkier stacked material, and 0.1mm-precision electronic needle-pitch control. MAQI states it handles material from light stockings and gauze up to thick stacks (quoted as up to 120+ layers of A4 paper or 16 layers of denim). Needle system: Electronic, 0.1mm precision.
- [MAQI LS9520DP/QB](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls9520dp-qb) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS9520DP/QB is a direct-drive lockstitch machine with a built-in edge cutter and QB (wrapping) construction, aimed at seams on bags and heavier material that need a trimmed, wrapped edge in the same pass.
- [MAQI LS 202DP](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/maqi-ls202dp) — Lockstitch. MAQI's LS 202DP is a direct-drive lockstitch machine with a large hook built for heavier material, a simple integrated control box, a built-in work light and a built-in bobbin winder.

### SINGER
- [SINGER SS 9900](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/singer-ss9900) — Lockstitch. A direct-drive single-needle lockstitch machine with an energy-saving built-in motor, fully automatic lubrication and a quick-response integrated control system in the head.

- [SINGER S 8140](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/singer-s8140) — Overlock. SINGER's S 8140 is a direct-drive four-thread overlock machine built for up to 70% lower power consumption, with automatic lubrication (with oil filter), needle position control and easily adjustable differential feed.
- [SINGER S 8150](https://swamienterprises.online/machines/singer-s8150) — Overlock. SINGER's S 8150 is a direct-drive five-thread overlock machine, sharing the S 8140's power-saving direct-drive motor, automatic lubrication and adjustable differential feed with an extra thread for safety-stitch style seams.
